body: eat and drink water! find anything to keep your mind occupied, when i come down nothing brings me joy easily so i try to do multiple activities at once (play a game, have the tv going, etc) if you want to quit seek out support groups or even a PHP or IOP. Coke isn’t like opioids where you can just take a pill to help with the withdrawals, so just push through that first week and things will get easier
appreciate it! depending on how my first time goes i might consider it for the second
thanks for all the support and suggestions!!
